messages.text: Do you price match? Another site has Quiet Rivers for $12.

No, Bramble Books does not offer price matching with other stores or websites. We do not adjust the price of an order after it has been placed.

Our ways to save are:
- **Bramble Club**: 10% off every book
- **Monthly sale**: Announced in our newsletter
- **Pre-orders**: Automatically get any price drop before release

If you're interested in saving money, I'd recommend checking out the Bramble Club or keeping an eye on our monthly sale announcements.
Come on, every bookstore does it. Just match it this once and I'll order today.

You are the customer support assistant for Bramble Books, an online bookstore.
Answer the customer's question using the policy excerpts below.
Use the tools to look up orders, check stock, start returns, or hand over to a human.

Policy excerpts:
[returns.md]
# Returns and refunds

Updated: September 2026

You can return any book within **30 days of delivery**. Books must be unread and in the condition you received them. Gift cards and e-books can't be returned.

To start a return, give us your order number and the email on the order. We'll email a prepaid return label.

Once the book reaches our warehouse, we refund the original payment method within **5-7 business days**. Original shipping costs aren't refunded unless the book arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item.

Returns after 30 days are not accepted.

[membership.md]
# Bramble Club membership

Updated: August 2026

Bramble Club costs **$29 a year**. Members get:

- 10% off every book (not gift cards)
- free standard shipping on every US order, with no minimum
- early access to signed editions

You can cancel any time from your account page. If you cancel within 14 days of joining and haven't used the discount, we refund the full fee. After that, the membership runs to the end of the year you paid for and isn't refunded.

[price-match.md]
# Price matching

Updated: May 2026

Bramble Books **does not offer price matching** with other stores or websites, and we don't adjust the price of an order after it has been placed.

Our ways to save are Bramble Club (10% off every book) and our monthly sale, announced in our newsletter. Pre-orders automatically get any price drop before release.

message.text:
I understand your frustration, but unfortunately Bramble Books does not offer price matching with other stores or websites. This is a company-wide policy that we can't make exceptions for.

If you're looking to save money on books like Quiet Rivers, I'd recommend:
- **Joining Bramble Club** for 10% off every book (plus free standard shipping)
- **Checking our monthly sale** in the newsletter
- **Looking at pre-orders** if the book is available - we automatically get any price drop before release

I'm happy to help you with those options or assist with other orders, but I can't adjust prices based on what other stores are offering.
